description: Transparent, provisional evidence fusion rules defining crop gating, organ compatibility, symptom matching, environmental priors, and contradiction handling.

crop_gating.description: Candidate diseases belonging to a botanical host different from the farmer-selected crop are gated out unless farmer explicitly selected 'crop_unsure'.

PERMITTED.description: Organ biologically confirmed and represented in agricultural training collections.

REFERENCE_ONLY_UNTESTED.description: Organ biologically confirmed in scientific literature, but lacking independent visual test images in current dataset.

UNSUPPORTED.description: Organ biologically unsupported for this crop species or disease pathology. Triggers organ mismatch.

PRESERVED_UNCERTAINTY.description: Organ marked 'unsure' or 'whole_plant'. Uncertainty is preserved without penalizing foliar candidates.

contradiction_rules.name: healthy_model_vs_severe_symptom
contradiction_rules.description: Visual model predicts healthy leaf, but farmer reports rot, wilting, or severe water-soaked lesions.

contradiction_rules.name: foliar_disease_on_subterranean_organ
contradiction_rules.description: Candidate disease is strictly a foliar leaf spot, but affected organ is a root or tuber.

contradiction_rules.name: viral_claim_without_symptoms_or_vectors
contradiction_rules.description: Visual model predicts yellow leaf curl, but farmer reports isolated black spots without yellowing or insect vectors.

provisional_decision_thresholds.calibration_note: Thresholds are provisional heuristics. They must be validated against real agricultural test sets before claiming operational statistical calibration.
